name: interface basic
code: <?php interface I { public function run(); } class C implements I { public function run(){ return "yes"; } } echo (new C())->run();

name: interface instanceof
code: <?php interface I { public function run(); } class C implements I { public function run(){ return 1; } } $x=new C(); echo $x instanceof I ? "yes" : "no";

name: interface mismatch false
code: <?php interface I { public function run(); } class C { public function run(){ return 1; } } $x=new C(); echo $x instanceof I ? "yes" : "no";

name: interface extends
code: <?php interface Base { public function base(); } interface I extends Base { public function run(); } class C implements I { public function base(){ return 2; } public function run(){ return 3; } } $x = new C(); echo $x->base()+$x->run();

name: multiple interface
code: <?php interface I { public function a(); } interface J { public function b(); } class C implements I, J { public function a(){ return 3; } public function b(){return 4;} } echo (new C())->a() + (new C())->b();

name: interface inheritance in class
code: <?php interface I {public function a();} class P implements I {public function a(){return 4;}} class C extends P {} $x=new C(); echo $x instanceof I ? "yes" : "no";

name: interface extends multiple
code: <?php interface A {public function a();} interface B {public function b();} interface C extends A,B {public function c();} class D implements C {public function a(){return 1;} public function b(){return 2;} public function c(){return 3;}} $x=new D(); echo $x instanceof A ? $x->a()+$x->b()+$x->c():0;

name: interface constant direct
code: <?php interface I { const CODE = 7; public function a(); } echo I::CODE;

name: interface constant inherited
code: <?php interface I { const CODE = 7; public function a(); } class C implements I {public function a(){return 3;}} echo C::CODE;

name: interface extends constant
code: <?php interface A {const CODE = 5;} interface B extends A {} echo B::CODE;

name: abstract method
code: <?php abstract class A { abstract public function score(); } class C extends A { public function score(){ return 8; } } echo (new C())->score();

name: abstract default method
code: <?php abstract class A { public function calc($n){return $n+3;} abstract public function score();} class C extends A {public function score(){return 5;}} echo (new C())->calc((new C())->score());

name: abstract inheritance
code: <?php abstract class A { abstract public function read(); } abstract class B extends A {} class C extends B { public function read(){return "ok";} } echo (new C())->read();

name: abstract extra optional args
code: <?php abstract class A { abstract public function calc($n); } class C extends A {public function calc($n,$more=2){return $n+$more;}} echo (new C())->calc(5);

name: abstract protected override
code: <?php abstract class A { abstract protected function show(); public function display(){return $this->show();} } class C extends A {public function show(){return "yes";}} echo (new C())->display();

name: final class usable
code: <?php final class C {public function a(){return 4;}} echo (new C())->a();

name: final method usable
code: <?php class P { final public function a(){return 6;} } class C extends P {} echo (new C())->a();

name: interface default argument
code: <?php interface I {public function run($x=5);} class C implements I {public function run($x=5){return $x;}} echo (new C())->run();

name: interface static function
code: <?php interface I {public static function run();} class C implements I {public static function run(){return 3;}} echo C::run();

name: interface abstract subclass
code: <?php interface I {public function run();} abstract class P implements I {} class C extends P {public function run(){return "yes";}} echo (new C())->run();

name: interface named args
code: <?php interface I {public function run($a,$b=2);} class C implements I {public function run($a,$b=2){return $a+$b;}} echo (new C())->run(b:4,a:3);

name: non-public helper
code: <?php interface I {public function run();} class C implements I {private function helper(){return 5;} public function run(){return $this->helper();}} echo (new C())->run();

name: abstract static function
code: <?php abstract class P {abstract public static function run();} class C extends P {public static function run(){return 9;}} echo C::run();
